verdict.rationale: Smooth's CLI docs say outright that the agent works with files in both directions: you can give it files to upload to websites, and it can download files from the web for you. That covers the core of upload, download and delivery back to the user. missing for 10: detailed docs on how downloaded artifacts are stored and retrieved afterwards (API endpoints, retention, formats), API-level (not just CLI) file transfer documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can download files from and upload files to the sites it operates, with the artifacts retrievable afterwards

citations.quote: Your agent can work with files in both directions - you can give it files to upload to websites, and it can download files from the web for you.
